finding: Panel selection decides whether a colocalisation claim is recoverable.

single_channel_LYVE1.visible_support: red fluorescent structures and a white boxed region, but no readable channel labels, green GFP signal, white arrowheads, or printed fold-change

merge_plus_GFP_plus_LYVE1.qualitative_outcome: GFP signal is present in LYVE-1-positive cells.

go004_note: The same call reports no fold-change printed anywhere in Figure 2B, so GO-004 17-fold ratio is in neither the cited text nor the figure.
implication: A vision stage that sends one crop per candidate will systematically miss colocalisation. Channel panels of the same field must travel together.
